decisions.reason: As a standalone check-in app launched just before a major shock to aviation, it now looks like a peripheral and weakly proven option whose remaining upside does not justify continued attention.

The branded launch of PassBoard and its close fit with airport passenger-processing and security activities make it the strongest strategic option to keep open while market adoption remains hard to judge.

This self-service check-in solution appears to overlap with the broader passenger-processing offer, and after several years without clear evidence of traction the option value is likely lower than the value of redeploying resources elsewhere.
